font.reason: Neutral SaaS product voice replacing the system sans; variable 100-900 so the original 700/800 weights are real, not faux bold.

comps.translatedSummary: «کارِ [فروش | گردش‌کار | مدیریت | گزارش] شما انجام شد» - the dark chip's wheel cycles four words, widening/narrowing and pushing the side texts.

rtlDecisions.why: direction:rtl via FaRoot: «کارِ» at the right, chip in the middle, «شما انجام شد» at the left; Persian copy is idiomatic, not literal.
paddingInlineStart reduced 18->12 (trailing slack 24) so emoji side and word side look optically equal given the emoji glyph's side bearing; verified at f5/f90/f130/f149.

rtlDecisions.what: Vertical wheel roll direction, ghost items above/below, half-speed parallax
Ghost horizontal centring, chip radius, drop shadow
rtlDecisions.why: Symmetric or straight down; nothing directional.
Removed; any letter-spacing breaks Persian joining.

Measured once at mount would use the fallback font; re-measured after the font loads under a delayRender. Review fix: the +74 slack (tuned to Latin metrics) left the Persian word cramped at the chip's trailing edge; now the whole row (emoji+gap+word) is measured and 36 padding added. Interpolation unchanged.
fs() x1.1 (30->33, 22->24, emoji 18->20) for smaller Persian x-height; FA_LH on side text.
Motion fidelity; word-length ratio stays under 2x (فروش vs گردش‌کار).

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets; only emoji, which are non-directional and kept.
concerns: Emoji glyph (system colour emoji) widths may still vary by platform, as noted in the source prompt.
lessons: Symptom: width-measuring effects (offsetWidth in a one-shot useLayoutEffect) size boxes from the fallback font -> cause: FaRoot's delayRender does not delay child mount-time measurement -> fix: re-measure after document.fonts.load(font, sample) inside its own delayRender.

Symptom: fixed '+N' slack in a measured chip looks unbalanced in Persian -> cause: slack was tuned to Latin word/emoji metrics -> fix: measure the full row (emoji+gap+word) and add explicit padding, then verify all words visually.
